highlights.description: Agent/team definition registry: a persistent, queryable inventory of agents and teams discovered across registered repos, with stable identity and dangling-reference detection

added.description: AgentDefinition and TeamDefinition ent entities, upserted from multi-agent-spec agent/team files, keyed by (repo, namespace, name) with a stable registry_xrn and source_ref
GET /api/registry/agents, GET /api/registry/teams, and POST /api/registry/sync endpoints
Registry sync wired into specui startup and the existing spec file watcher, coalesced through a buffered channel
Team sync delegates dangling-reference detection to multi-agent-spec's Team.ValidateAgentReferences (v0.10.0), covering the roster, orchestrator, and agent-assigned workflow steps

fixed.description: AgentDefinition.namespace now defaults to "" instead of being nullable, so every create path participates in the (repo_name, namespace, name) unique identity constraint
Concurrent registry syncs (watcher-triggered and HTTP-triggered) no longer race on Create against the unique index; Sync is now serialized behind a mutex
A team's agent membership edges now refresh on every sync instead of only when the team file's content hash changes, fixing agents that register after the team file referencing them
The registry sync HTTP handler no longer echoes internal error details (filesystem paths, DB internals) to the caller

tests.description: Sync test suite covering create/idempotency/content-change-detection, dangling-reference warnings, malformed-file resilience, and identity stability across file renames

documentation.description: README: document the new registry API endpoints

internal.description: Bump github.com/plexusone/multi-agent-spec dependency to v0.10.0 and update Go module dependencies

highlights.description: Visual multi-agent workflow designer with React Flow canvas for exploring agent team specifications
Gmail-style floating panels for viewing agent details with drag, resize, and minimize
Persistent views to save and restore UI layouts using Ent ORM with SQLite/PostgreSQL

added.description: React Flow canvas for visualizing agent workflows with custom nodes and edges
Gmail-style floating panels for agent details with drag, resize, minimize, and close controls
Multiple floating panels support with staggered positioning (like Gmail compose windows)
Panel header colors match agent model type (opus=red, sonnet=blue, haiku=green)
2x2 grid layout for viewing up to 4 agent teams simultaneously
Views dropdown to save, load, update, and delete UI layouts
Markdown rendering with syntax highlighting for agent instructions
Team selector sidebar with checkboxes for multi-team selection
Resizable sidebar with drag handle
Go HTTP server with agent team API endpoints
File watcher for hot-reloading spec changes without server restart
Ent ORM schema for Views entity with SQLite and PostgreSQL support
Views REST API for CRUD operations on saved layouts
Environment-based database configuration (DB_DRIVER, DB_DSN)
CLI entry point with workspace and port flags
Embedded frontend assets in Go binary
